title: Minute clip
description: About once a minute, read the wave number, record a 10-second clip of the game, and append a spreadsheet row. Outranks the A/B tick while recording.
notes: Clip name uses run number + wave from the pre-clip OCR.

actions.description: Snapshot the anchored window just before recording.
Read the WAVE band and parse the number used in the clip filename.
Echo the parsed wave into the console.
Record 10 seconds of the anchored window to runs/clips/.
Append datetime, run_number, and wave_number to runs/run_log.csv.
